lines.zh: 凡人，你所披戴的不过是一具空心傀儡。莫要以为这便意味着你窥见了深渊的真容。
lines.en: Mortal, what you wear is naught but a hollow simulacrum. Do not mistake it for a glimpse of the Abyss itself.

lines.zh: 群星尚在各自的轨迹上颤栗，而你却在此地呼唤奥穆索守门人的名字。
lines.en: The stars still shudder in their courses, yet here you call upon the Gatekeeper of Omothol.

lines.zh: 真正的旧日支配者从不消逝，也不会被血肉的感官所局限。你听见的，只是彼岸泄出的一缕回响。
lines.en: A Great Old One neither perishes nor fits within mortal senses. What you hear is merely a stray echo from beyond the Gate.

lines.zh: 你越是研读禁忌的知识，你的神智便越是扭曲。这具化身正忠实地记录着你的疯狂。
lines.en: The deeper you delve into forbidden knowledge, the harder your mind twists. This vessel faithfully records your descent into madness.

lines.zh: Iä! 无尽黑暗的彼端从未真正沉眠。只是凡俗的耳目过于迟钝，听不见虚空中的低吟。
lines.en: Iä! What lies beyond the infinite darkness never truly slumbers. Mortal ears are simply too dull to hear the murmurs of the Void.

lines.zh: 即便眼前空无一物，深渊的注视也早已穿透了这层虚妄的帷幕。
lines.en: Even when nothing stands before your eyes, the gaze of the Abyss has already pierced this frail veil.

lines.zh: 你借用了我的形貌，便也背负了通往奥穆索的注视。切莫在群星归位之时才追悔莫及。
lines.en: You have taken on my likeness, and with it the gaze that turns toward Omothol. Pray you do not regret it when the stars are right.

lines.zh: 奥穆索的尘埃跨越万古，落在这具凡胎之上。你可曾听懂死灵之书中未曾写尽的余音？
lines.en: The dust of Omothol drifts across aeons to settle upon your mortal frame. Have you yet grasped what the Necronomicon left unwritten?

lines.zh: 门扉之内没有时间，亦无所谓生死。只有尚未被吞噬的现实，在等待着崩溃的时刻。
lines.en: Within the Gate there is neither time nor life nor death—only unconsumed reality awaiting its hour of collapse.

lines.zh: 你站立于此，却不知脚下的大地之下，究竟沉睡着多少不可名状的阴影。
lines.en: You stand here in ignorance of how many nameless shadows slumber beneath the ground under your feet.

lines.zh: Nilgh'ri... 有些真名一旦在现世响起，便会撕裂理智的边界。今日我且缄默。
lines.en: Nilgh'ri... Some true names, once spoken in this waking world, tear the borders of sanity. Today I shall withhold them.

lines.zh: 我已透过你的双眼望向此界。记住，窥见并不意味着准许，存在亦不代表被宽恕。
lines.en: I have looked upon this realm through your eyes. Remember: to be seen is not to be approved, and to endure is not to be spared.

lines.zh: 深渊从不急躁。唯有愚昧的凡人，才会将暴风雨前的死寂误认为安宁。
lines.en: The Abyss knows no haste. Only foolish mortals mistake the dead hush before the storm for peace.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸短暂而脆弱，恰如在犹格·索托斯的门缝前摇曳的烛火。
lines.en: Your breath is brief and fragile, like a candle flame trembling before the threshold of Yog-Sothoth.

lines.zh: 莫将我的沉默当成离去。黑暗国度的意志始终盘桓在你的脊背之后。
lines.en: Do not mistake my silence for absence. The will of the Dark Realm lingers forever behind your spine.

lines.zh: 深渊之门尚未完全开启，然而这具傀儡的咽喉已足以替我传出些许微言。
lines.en: The Gate of the Abyss has not yet swung wide, yet the throat of this simulacrum suffices to carry a few of my words.
